children: U.S. President Donald Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) plan to meet with at the White House with some of the nation's top tech executives to discuss artificial intelligence.

The meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, Sept. 29, and comes following a rising chorus of experts sounding the alarm on the destructive potential of AI if the proper guardrails aren't in place. The meeting was first reported by Axios.

Trump recently disregarded these warnings as a "hoax," insisting U.S. AI firms must continue to push the boundaries of the technology to win the global AI race, particularly against China. Johnson said he wants Trump and executives to "go in a big room, close the door and sort this out."
"There'll be a deliberate discussion about the responsibility of the companies to maintain safety, and what role, if any, the government has to play in that," Johnson said last week.
Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a state dinner on Thursday night with an array of tech executives, such as Google
that Xi agreed with his decision to rename artificial intelligence to super intelligence. Trump never liked the term artificial.

title: Trump, Johnson plan meeting with tech execs to discuss AI safety
